process.heading: A clear process.
process.description: You speak directly with the people building your system. We keep decisions visible and agree what we need from each other.

items.name: Tell us your idea
items.description: We talk through the problem, the people using the system, and what needs to work better.
items.effort: You bring: context, priorities, and a look at your current tools.

items.name: We propose a direction
items.description: We outline an approach, define the scope, and agree the next steps before the build starts.
items.effort: You help: choose priorities and approve the agreed scope.

items.name: Build it together
items.description: We design and develop in focused rounds, with clear opportunities to review the work.
items.effort: You provide: content, access, and feedback from one main contact.

items.name: Launch and grow
items.description: We prepare the handover, check the system together, and plan what happens after launch.
items.effort: You take part: test key tasks and agree the handover.

support.heading: Live is a beginning.
support.description: A system needs a plan for the everyday. We’ll agree what you look after, where we can help, and how to approach the next improvement.

items.name: Care & maintenance
items.description: Agree responsibility for updates, checks, and the things that keep your system working.

items.name: Hosting & ownership
items.description: Choose a suitable home for the system and make access and responsibilities clear.

items.name: Room to improve
items.description: Use real feedback to decide which small improvement is worth making next.

faq.heading: Good questions.
faq.description: A few things you might want to know before we talk.

items.question: How does a project start?
items.answer: With a conversation about your goals, users, and current setup. We then propose a direction and agree the scope before starting the build. You do not need a finished technical brief.

items.question: What will my project cost?
items.answer: That depends on the scope, the integrations, and the content or functionality you need. We discuss these together and set out the proposed work and costs before you decide to proceed.

items.question: Who owns the system, and what happens at handover?
items.answer: Ownership, licences, account access, and handover materials are agreed as part of the project scope. We make clear what you receive, which third-party services are involved, and how your team will manage the system.

items.question: Can you help with hosting and ongoing care?
items.answer: We can discuss hosting, maintenance, and future improvements alongside the build. Responsibilities and the scope of ongoing support are agreed separately so everyone knows what happens after launch.

items.question: What do you need from us?
items.answer: A main contact, your priorities, relevant content, access to the tools involved, and timely feedback at the agreed review points. We will explain what is needed and when.

items.question: How long will it take?
items.answer: We work out a schedule once we understand the scope, dependencies, and availability of your team. Content, integrations, and review rounds all affect the plan; we agree milestones together.
